## Appearance

Sam is a youth who is very tall and lank in stature. He is also characterized by his tow-colored hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008)_

## History

Sam is a taciturn hired boy who works at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet's home on [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road). Recognized as a good worker, he has saved some of his earned money in the bank. During Anne's stay at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), she observes him as one of the peculiar local figures in the area.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P2](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIX.
